headline: Vivo V80 Reportedly Up ₹5,000 to ₹67,999 Since October Launch

fact_sources.fact: Vivo V80 reportedly +₹5,000 on all 3 variants: 8+128 ₹62,999->₹67,999; 8+256 ₹69,999->₹74,999; 8+512 ₹79,999->₹84,999 (mid-Nov 2026; MyMobileIndia says effective 15 Nov); not announced by Vivo
V80 launched in India 6 Oct 2026 at ₹62,999 / ₹69,999 / ₹79,999; sale from 13 Oct
Vivo S2 launched Aug 2026 at ₹39,999 (8+128), ₹44,999 (8+256); sale from 11 Aug; rose to ₹42,999 / ₹48,999 (Beebom, 25 Sep)
New prices apply offline and online; reason reportedly memory/storage chip costs (outlets' explanation, not Vivo's)

tag_decision: Main dropped @vivo_india: vivo's own sites don't link the handle and the only confirmations were analytics sites (HypeAuditor, Qoruz); the rule needs the official website or two credible sources.
